general.name: OpenCut-app/OpenCut
general.description_zh: 开源的 CapCut 替代方案
features: 免费开源的视频编辑器，支持 web、桌面和移动端
基于 Rust core 单一代码库覆盖桌面、移动和浏览器
plugin-first 架构支持第一方及第三方插件
提供 Editor API 与面向 AI agent 的 MCP server
支持 headless 模式，实现自动化与批量渲染

general.name: Dicklesworthstone/destructive_command_guard
general.description: The Destructive Command Guard (dcg) is for blocking dangerous git and shell commands from being executed by agents.

general.name: moeru-ai/airi
general.description: 💖🧸 Self hosted, you-owned Grok Companion, a container of souls of waifu, cyber livings to bring them into our worlds, wishing to achieve Neuro-sama's altitude. Capable of realtime voice chat, Minecraft, Factorio playing. Web / macOS / Windows supported.
general.description_zh: 💖🧸 自托管、完全归你所有的 Grok 伴侣，承载 waifu 与赛博生命之魂的容器，将她们带入我们的世界，立志达到 Neuro-sama 的高度。支持实时语音对话、Minecraft、Factorio 游玩。兼容 Web / macOS / Windows。
features: 重塑 Neuro-sama，打造 AI waifu 虚拟角色容器
支持多语言界面与跨平台桌面客户端发布
集成 Discord、Telegram、QQ 等多平台社区交互

general.name: Shubhamsaboo/awesome-llm-apps
general.description: 100+ AI Agent & RAG apps you can actually run — clone, customize, ship.

general.name: Nutlope/hallmark
general.description: Anti-AI-slop design skill for Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex.

general.name: Raphire/Win11Debloat
general.description: A simple, lightweight PowerShell script that allows you to remove pre-installed apps, disable telemetry, as well as perform various other changes to declutter and customize your Windows experience. Win11Debloat works for both Windows 10 and Windows 11.

general.name: Graphify-Labs/graphify
general.description: AI coding assistant skill (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and more). Turn any folder of code, SQL schemas, R scripts, shell scripts, docs, papers, images, or videos into a queryable knowledge graph. App code + database schema + infrastructure in one graph.
general.description_zh: AI 编码助手技能（适用于 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、Cursor、Gemini CLI 等）。将任意包含代码、SQL schema、R 脚本、shell 脚本、文档、论文、图片或视频的文件夹转化为可查询的知识图谱。应用代码 + 数据库 schema + 基础设施一图汇总。

general.name: hasaneyldrm/exercises-dataset
general.description: 1,324-exercise fitness dataset — animation GIFs, 180×180 thumbnails, muscle-group & equipment data, and step-by-step instructions in 6 languages. The exercise data layer behind the LogPress app.

general.name: github/spec-kit
general.description: 💫 Toolkit to help you get started with Spec-Driven Development
general.description_zh: 💫 助你快速上手规范驱动开发的工具包
features: 将 specification 转化为可执行产物，直接生成可运行的实现代码
提供 Specify CLI，支持持久化或一次性安装并初始化项目
原生集成多种 AI coding agent，支撑 Spec-Driven Development 工作流
支持 Community Extensions 与 Presets，可自定义扩展工具链
以阶段化流程引导从产品场景到可预测交付的开发过程

general.name: coreyhaines31/marketingskills
general.description: Marketing skills for Claude Code and AI agents. CRO, copywriting, SEO, analytics, and growth engineering.
general.description_zh: 面向 Claude Code 和 AI agent 的营销技能集，涵盖 CRO、文案撰写、SEO、数据分析与增长工程。
features: 专为技术型营销人员打造的 AI agent 营销技能集合
兼容 Claude Code、OpenAI Codex、Cursor、Windsurf 等 agent
涵盖 CRO、copywriting、SEO、analytics 与 growth engineering
以 product-marketing skill 为基础，各 skill 相互引用协作
基于 Agent Skills spec，以 markdown 文件形式提供专业工作流
